NSH::chain
       Sets the Chain for flow.

SYNOPSIS
       NSH::chain DIRECTION CHAIN_NAME

DESCRIPTION
       Set: chain for NSH.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	# Set the context for NSH.
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    NSH::chain clientside_ingress test1
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-13.1.0
		       --First introduced the command.
